origin: Vihtavuori reloading data shotgun 12/76, lead and steel shot (2020; scripts/data/loaddata/vv_shot_extract.py, analysis/fit_vv_shot.py)
descr: FOR SHOTSHELLS ONLY (caliber with Shotshell = yes). The burn rate Ba is fitted to 14 start and maximum loads of Vihtavuori's published 12/76 shotgun tables (lead and steel shot, 28 inch barrel, velocities only, no pressures) with the shotshell model of the solver: velocity error 2.6 % rms; no load of the tables may exceed the C.I.P. maximum of 1050 bar in the model (the velocities alone do not determine Ba without pressures). Pressures are not published and so not fitted: they vary with wad and primer, which the model does not know. With a rifle or handgun cartridge the value is wrong: use the other record of this powder. Qex (energy content) and pcd (bulk density) as published by Vihtavuori; not published and therefore only typical values: k, material density, form function. Check every load against the manufacturer's current load data.
